SITE INFORMATION

Privacy Policy

What happens to the numbers you enter and the information involved in visiting this website.

Last updated: September 24, 2026

Regular calculation is processed in your browser. If you choose “Extract numbers with AI,” the text you entered is sent to Cloudflare Workers AI for parsing.

Calculator input

For regular calculation, your entries and results remain in the open page on your device. We do not require an account or store your calculation history. The “Copy total” button uses your browser’s clipboard feature only when you select it. Closing or reloading the page clears your entries.

Optional AI parsing

If you click “Extract numbers with AI,” the text currently in the input box is sent to our Cloudflare Worker and processed by Cloudflare Workers AI. The Worker returns a proposed list of numbers for you to review. We do not intentionally store the text or the extracted list. Do not submit sensitive information through this optional feature. Cloudflare may process the request under its privacy policy. If the daily AI allowance is exhausted, the AI feature may be unavailable while regular calculation continues to work.

Website visits

Like other websites, the hosting and security services that deliver this site may process technical information needed to serve pages and protect the service. This may include your IP address, request time, browser details, and requested page. When this site is hosted by Cloudflare, Cloudflare may process that information under its own privacy policy. This information is separate from the numbers you enter into the calculator.

Cookies and analytics

We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how people use the site. Google may receive page views, referral information, browser and device details, and interactions with the site. Its tag may set first-party cookies, including _ga and _ga_*, to distinguish visits. We do not send the numbers you enter as custom analytics events. Learn more in Google’s Privacy Policy. You can manage or block cookies in your browser settings.

Third-party badge and links

The home page displays a badge image hosted by Findly.tools. Loading that image sends a request from your browser to Findly.tools, which may receive standard request information such as your IP address and browser details. If you follow the badge link, Findly.tools handles that visit under its own privacy practices. Other external links are governed by their operators’ policies.

Changes to this policy

We may update this page as the site evolves. The date above shows when it was last revised. Please review it when you return if you want to know the current practices.

Questions

For privacy questions, write to yimin.space.fe@gmail.com.
